entries.final_answer: The test is stale and the model is right. CharterYaml's 13 activation fields are intentional: #6556 added activated_glossary_packs, activated_skills and activated_anti_patterns because the activation writer writes them to charter.yaml, ACTIVATION_YAML_KEYS (the single vocabulary authority) holds exactly 13, and the model-vs-authority parity gate is green. The test's hard-coded len(...) == 10 was true at #6496 when the model had ten and went stale; it also derived its names from the model, so it could never detect a wrong key set. Fix: take the field set from pack_manager.ACTIVATION_YAML_KEYS, keep the behavioural model_validate + real-CLI proof, add a non-vacuity guard, and rename the test.
options: The test is stale: derive from the vocabulary authority
The model is wrong: remove three fields
Pin the intended count with a rationale
entries.question: The acceptance test pins 10 activation fields and CharterYaml declares 13. Is the test stale or is the model wrong?
